H01.description: RouteShorthandHook rebuilds the hook signature from Parameters<T> only, dropping the hook's `this` type, so shorthand route hooks lose their `this` (FastifyInstance) typing.

I01.description: The addresses() return type has nothing to do with this change's route hook typing, and the packet does not show head instance.d.ts, so I can't confirm it was already wrong at head.

I02.description: RouteShorthandOptions at head has no logSerializers per-route option, even though the runtime accepts and documents it.
